prompt: Animate THIS EXACT approved creature, preserving its silhouette, anatomy, carved ivory mask, braided wood limbs, turquoise cloth with gold trim, amber eye and green leaves. Create a PRODUCTION TRANSPARENT sprite sheet: exactly FOUR equal columns and SEVEN equal rows = 28 frames. Tall 4:7 canvas. No text, labels, grid, borders, shadows outside the creature, projectiles, particles, or baked flash. Fixed side camera facing RIGHT. SAME PHYSICAL SCALE in every cell. Generous empty gutters, nothing touches cell boundaries. Fixed horizontal body anchor; a common floor at 85% of every cell (for flyer common flight center). Same detailed pixel clusters as reference; NOT smooth illustration and NOT coarse oversized blocks. Each row is four consecutive DISTINCT articulated poses, not a translated or resized duplicate. Rows in strict order: 1 idle breathing loop, 2 movement loop, 3 attack anticipation neutral-to-ready, 4 attack action, 5 recovery back to idle, 6 hurt recoil returning balance, 7 death buckle/fall to final inert corpse. No disappearance. Preserve character's identity in every frame. Upright wooden hare with powerful long hindlegs, long leaf ears and small front paws. Idle small knee flex and ear twitch. Move compress, push off, airborne extended legs, landing crouch, registered to same floor. Anticipation progressively deep leg compression and forward lean. Attack leaps forward into tucked knees then extends feet for landing, no image translation. Recovery deep landing knee bend then rise. Hurt chest leans back, one paw balances. Death folds knees then falls on its side, leaf ears fold.
